slug: 2025-11-27 Interoperability - key workshop to modernize Guinea's health information system

facts.fact: A November 2025 workshop in Conakry, part of the drive to strengthen the SNIS, was told that aggregated data from the REC maternité register piloted in 15 health centres would feed the SNIS, and a ministry official framed the aim as centralising national health information in one system.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene
